entities.name: Q6PBF6
observations: Reviewed Xenopus tropicalis guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase; query sequence is an exact full-length match (232 aa).
Catalyzes guanidinoacetate methylation using S-adenosyl-L-methionine to produce creatine and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine (EC 2.1.1.2; Rhea RHEA:10656).
Associated with creatine biosynthesis; annotated in cytoplasm and nucleus.
Pfam GuanidinoAc_N-MeTrfase domain spans query residues 5–231.

entities.name: Creatine biosynthesis
observations: Guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase catalyzes the terminal conversion of guanidinoacetate to creatine in the creatine biosynthetic pathway.
